# searchstax_deployment_rolling_restart (Resource)





## Import

Importing an existing rolling-restart resource records it in Terraform state without initiating another restart. Use `account_name/deployment_uid` as the import identifier.

```shell
terraform import searchstax_deployment_rolling_restart.example account_name/deployment_uid
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_name` (String)
- `deployment_uid` (String)

### Optional

- `solr` (Boolean)
- `triggers` (Map of String) Arbitrary map of values that, when changed, forces a new rolling restart. Use it to trigger a single restart when the custom jar list changes.
- `zookeeper` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `message` (String)
